scalars.scalar_value: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience required.

A minimum of 2 years of experience as a coach at the collegiate or professional level of athletics. Collegiate playing and/or coaching experience preferred. Experience in the recruitment of academically focused scholar-athletes is preferred. Capacity to positively interact with and support a culturally, ethnically, economically, and socially diverse population of students, faculty, and staff.

This part-time position's hours are 15-20 hours per week, depending on the competitive season. Must be available for extensive weekend and evening hours during the season. Travel may be required. Must be willing to work a flexible schedule.

items.item_text: A valid driver’s license is required or an equivalent means of reliable transportation to off-site games, meetings, and events.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience required.

A minimum of 2 years of experience as a coach at the collegiate or professional level of athletics. Collegiate playing and/or coaching experience preferred. Experience in the recruitment of academically focused scholar-athletes is preferred. Capacity to positively interact with and support a culturally, ethnically, economically, and socially diverse population of students, faculty, and staff.
Support the development and performance of the program’s special teams units.
Coaching kickers, long snappers, and other relevant specialists.
Attend Thursday practices and Saturday game days.
Evaluate practice and game film footage.
Assist with special teams’ preparation and strategy.
Serve as an asset in identifying and recruiting prospective student-athletes.
